tools.name: mcp__codex_apps__bykaranteli_get_coverage
tools.description:
Call this when the user asks which exchanges sit behind a ByKaranteli number, whether a feed is complete or sampled, since when a venue is collected, or how fresh the data is. Returns the live coverage registry: liquidation feeds per venue with kind and last record, snapshot feeds per venue and market, funding arbitrage legs, positioning sources, whale tape, spot minutes and the Hyperliquid whale scan with freshness. snapshots[].country is the jurisdiction only when the venue states one; it is null for most venues, so do not read null as unknown risk. This tool is part of plugin `ByKaranteli`.

Tools for working with ByKaranteli.

```ts

```
